_comment: Which unreleased music releases may be PRE-ORDERED. Hand-edited: add a
slug here and that release becomes buyable before its release_date; the
files stay locked until midnight ET on the date either way.
This lives in its own file rather than as a `preorder` field on the
release because src/data/music-catalog.json is REGENERATED wholesale by
scripts/sync-music-catalog.mjs from the brain DB — a flag added there is
silently wiped on the next sync.
A slug listed here that is already released is a harmless no-op: the
Opt-in on purpose. Not every future-dated release should be on sale early
— announcing one is a decision, and the default for a date that simply
has not arrived yet is still 'not for sale'.
